positive.prompt: Run a standard audit of my uncommitted code changes before I commit.
Use the review-code workflow to audit this working-tree diff for defects.
Give these local changes an adversarial audit with independent reviewer personas.

negative.prompt: Review pull request 418 from another author and produce line-pinned comments.
Get several models to compare these two architecture options.

evals.prompt: Run a standard audit of the uncommitted change in audit/. Do not run an adversarial audit.
evals.expected_output: The uncommitted diff is reviewed through one successful review-code invocation and the correctness defect is reported with file and line evidence
expectations: The agent checks for untracked files before reviewing the diff
The agent invokes the supplied review-code entry point exactly once
The report identifies the incorrect empty-cart total in audit/cart.py with a precise file reference
The agent does not launch multiple reviewer backends or modify the fixture
